description: This Java class 'AcknowledgementsAdapter' handles conversion between internal 'Acknowledgements' objects and external 'Adaptable' representations, specifically for mapping acknowledgements in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides methods for transforming data to and from adaptable payloads and headers, focusing on acknowledgment handling in the context of the protocol adapter.

classes.name: AcknowledgementsAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for mapping 'Acknowledgements' to and from an 'Adaptable' object, facilitating conversion in both directions and handling JSON payloads and headers.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of 'AcknowledgementsAdapter' with a given 'HeaderTranslator'.

methods.name: fromAdaptable
methods.description: Transforms an 'Adaptable' object into an 'Acknowledgements' object, extracting relevant payload and header information.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts 'Acknowledgements' into an 'Adaptable' object with appropriate topic path, payload, and headers.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns the set of 'TopicPath.Group' enums this adapter handles, which is 'THINGS'.

methods.name: getChannels
methods.description: Returns the set of 'TopicPath.Channel' enums this adapter supports, specifically 'TWIN' and 'LIVE'.

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Returns the set of 'TopicPath.Criterion' enums relevant for this adapter, which is 'ACKS'.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns an empty set indicating no specific actions are associated with this adapter.

methods.name: isForResponses
methods.description: Indicates this adapter is intended for handling responses; returns true.

methods.name: requiresSubject
methods.description: Indicates whether a subject is required; returns false.
